verdict.rationale: Shopify's authentication docs say an app or agent obtains an access token scoped to only the permissions it needs, with access scopes controlling what it can reach. That is first-party, least-privilege credential issuance usable by an agent. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the scope catalog and how credentials are issued and revoked, agent-specific credential guidance (e.g., for UCP/MCP agents), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Your code obtains an access token scoped to the permissions it needs.
its access scopes determine what it can access
